sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture on excellent form, having won four of their last five matches (with one draw), and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just four points from ten games. This should be a straightforward home fixture for the in-form leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a mid-table clash, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a fixture between two of the division's stronger sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community in a local derby. Bilston Town, sitting sixth, face Foley Meir at home as both teams look to maintain or build momentum. Barnton host struggling Shawbury United, who have won just once in their last five outings. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills in a clash between mid-to-lower table sides, while Brereton Social entertain winless Widnes Town—the visitors having collected just two points all season. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath in a contest between sides in the lower reaches of the table. All fixtures kick off at 15:00 on Saturday 3 October.
